title: Accelerating Genome Alignment Pipeline with In-NAND Search Technology and Group Testing Techniques
problem: Genome alignment pipelines bottleneck on computational complexity of aligning short reads to reference genomes; existing exact-match filters require expensive NAND page-by-page loading.
method: Novel SSD architecture leveraging computing-in-NAND-flash with group testing enabling comparisons across hundreds of pages per read cycle and simultaneous multi-query searches.
key_novelty: First in-NAND search architecture with group testing for accelerated genome sequence alignment.
contributions: Group testing methods for concurrent multi-query searches
48-96% reduction in data movement vs GenStore
primary_theme: In-NAND computing for accelerated genome sequence alignment
